name: Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport, GDP-fucose and glycosphingolipid synthesis
rationale: Members are defects of Golgi nucleotide-sugar/acetyl-CoA transporters (SLC35A1/A2/A3/C1, SLC33A1) plus GDP-fucose and glycosphingolipid/ganglioside synthesis; the glycosphingolipid and GDP-fucose arms separate it from N-glycan- and UDP-sugar-focused neighbours.

name: FGFR4 signaling and FGFR phospholipase C cascades
rationale: All members are FGFR downstream cascades; the FGFR4 FRS/SHC/PI3K arms with betaKlotho binding and the PLC cascades for FGFR1/3/4 distinguish it from PI3K-centred FGFR1-3 neighbours.

name: TCR proximal signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members cover TCR phosphorylation, ZAP-70 recruitment, second messengers and IL-2 output; CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition set it apart from BCR and T cell differentiation neighbours.

name: Vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation and migration control
rationale: All members positively or negatively regulate vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation, migration or differentiation, without the phenotypic-switching, dedifferentiation and endothelial terms of its neighbours.

name: Redox, aldehyde detoxification and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members span ROS and methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification, NADPH regeneration and protein repair, and uniquely include direct DNA alkylation reversal (ALKBH2/3, MGMT, oxidative demethylation) absent from glutathione/ferroptosis neighbours.

name: Opsin-mediated phototransduction and light detection
rationale: Members concern opsins, activation and recovery of the phototransduction cascade, cone opsin defects and light responses, distinguishing it from retinoid-cycle and photoreceptor development neighbours.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation, Sanfilippo and Morquio mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: All members are heparan, keratan or chondroitin/dermatan sulfate degradation or their MPS III/IV deficiencies; Sanfilippo and Morquio forms separate it from neighbours holding Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Maroteaux-Lamy.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and erythroid-myeloid progenitor differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and erythroid-myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, division and differentiation (RUNX1) and erythroid/myeloid progenitor output, unlike neighbours focused on bone-marrow B cell or negative myeloid differentiation control.

qualifier: netrin and semaphorin cues with projection extension
name: Netrin and semaphorin axon guidance with projection extension
rationale: Members are axon guidance and extension processes including netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling; netrin signaling and positive axon extension distinguish it from chemorepulsion-centred neighbours.

name: Pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis: resolvins, protectins, maresins, lipoxins
rationale: Members are lipoxygenase-derived PUFA mediator syntheses (resolvins, protectins, maresins, lipoxins, HETEs), unlike leukotriene, hepoxilin and eicosanoid-catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: elongation, peroxisomal oxidation and ether lipid synthesis
name: Fatty acid elongation, peroxisomal oxidation and ether lipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover very-long-chain fatty acid elongation, peroxisomal alpha/beta/omega-oxidation, PUFA and plasmalogen/ether lipid synthesis, distinct from peroxisomal protein import and bile acid neighbours.

qualifier: putrescine and spermidine synthesis and transport
name: Putrescine and spermidine synthesis and transport
rationale: Members concern ODC-driven putrescine synthesis, spermidine metabolism and polyamine transport, unlike neighbours on polyamine interconversion/oxidation, organic cation transport or ornithine/urea cycle.

name: Eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and effector function
rationale: Members are eosinophil differentiation, activation, chemotaxis and immunity plus mast cell/granulocyte differentiation, distinct from Th2 cytokine-signaling neighbours.

core: Cytoplasmic mRNA decay and translational control
qualifier: AU-rich element binding proteins and stress granules
name: ARE-mediated mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover deadenylation, decapping and ARE-binding proteins (TTP, HuR, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1) plus stress granule and PKR responses, distinct from miRNA/siRNA silencing neighbours.

name: Amino sugar and mannose catabolism via fructose 6-phosphate
rationale: Members are GlcNAc, glucosamine, sialic acid and mannose catabolism feeding fructose 6-phosphate, unlike neighbours on UDP-GlcNAc/CMP-sialic acid synthesis and nucleotide-sugar transport.

name: Notch target transcription via NOTCH3 and NOTCH4
rationale: Members concern Notch-driven HLH target transcription and its regulation; NOTCH3/NOTCH4 intracellular domains distinguish it from NOTCH1/NOTCH2 neighbours.

qualifier: focal adhesion assembly and cell spreading
name: Integrin focal adhesion assembly and substrate-dependent cell spreading
rationale: Members cover integrin/syndecan/fibronectin adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly with MET-FAK/tensin signaling and cell spreading, distinct from ECM-composition and Rho-effector neighbours.

name: Purinergic receptor signaling and extracellular ATP turnover
rationale: Members are P2Y and adenosine receptor signaling, ATP export and NTPDase hydrolysis, distinct from other GPCR and KATP channel neighbours.

name: Dopamine receptor G protein and arrestin signaling
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor signaling via adenylate cyclase, PLC and beta-arrestin at the postsynapse, distinct from cAMP/DARPP-32 and drug-response behavioural neighbours.

name: Regulation of appetite and nutrient-level responses
rationale: All three members regulate appetite and responses to food or nutrient levels, unlike HPA-axis and eating-behaviour neighbours.

name: Execution-phase cell death: DNA fragmentation, lamina breakdown, involution
rationale: Members cover apoptotic DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and lamina breakdown plus developmental and autophagic death in involution, unlike PAK-2p34, dependence-receptor and necroptosis neighbours.

name: Organelle acidification and bicarbonate, anion and sodium-proton exchange
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase organelle acidification, carbonic anhydrase, SLC4 bicarbonate, SLC26 anion and Na+/H+ exchangers and their defects, distinct from phosphate, chloride-cotransporter and P-type ATPase neighbours.

core: Negative regulation of angiogenesis and adhesion
name: Inhibition of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis and cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: Members negatively regulate VEGF signaling, endothelial sprouting and chemotaxis together with Rho/Rac, integrin and focal adhesion-dependent adhesion, combining the arms its neighbours split.

qualifier: autophagosome biogenesis control and endolysosomal fusion
name: Autophagosome biogenesis regulation and lysosomal vesicle fusion
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly/maturation and fusion of autophagosomes, endosomes, MVBs and phagosomes with lysosomes, unlike selective autophagy (mitophagy, pexophagy) neighbours.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis
rationale: Members concern phenylalanine/tyrosine metabolism, phenylketonuria and BH4 synthesis with generic amino/organic acid terms, distinct from glycine, threonine, proline and sulfur amino acid neighbours.
